# CPL0 system instructions (ledger U801-U829): expected values from the independent model
# Emulator/tools/isa/ref_sysins.py (regenerate with --write, do not edit). Unicorn only, MAX
# model (CPL0 instructions; the i5-13600K lacks most of them):
#   emu-alltest --cases Emulator\data\cases_sysins.txt --expect-only
# Without cpl=3 the snippet runs at CPL0; cpl=3 runs it at CPL3 (U452).
# --- WRMSRNS (NP 0F 01 C6, U801): EDX:EAX -> MSR[ECX], high halves of RAX/RCX/RDX ignored;
# read back with RDMSR; REX ignored
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xba, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0xFFFFFFFFC0000102 rax=0xAAAAAAAA89ABCDEF rdx=0x55555555FFFF8000 => rax=0x89ABCDEF rdx=0xFFFF8000
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xba, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0xC0000102 rax=0x12345678 rdx=0x7FFF =>
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xba, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0xE1 rax=0x186A1 rdx=0x0 =>
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xba, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0xD93 rax=0x800ABCDE rdx=0x0 =>
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xba, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0x1B01 rax=0x1 rdx=0x0 =>
.byte 0x48, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xba, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0x1B01 rax=0x0 rdx=0x0 =>
.byte 0x41, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xba, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0xE1 rax=0x100 rdx=0x0 =>
# reserved MSR bits -> #GP(0), registers and the MSR unchanged
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0xE1 rax=0x2 rdx=0x0 => #GP
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0xE1 rax=0x0 rdx=0x1 => #GP
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0xD93 rax=0x100000 rdx=0x0 => #GP
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1B01 rax=0x2 rdx=0x0 => #GP
.byte 0xb9, 0x01, 0x1b, 0x00, 0x00, 0xb8, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xba, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb8, 0x02, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 => rax=0x2 rcx=0x1B01 #GP
# LOCK / 66 -> #UD; CPL3 -> #GP(0)
.byte 0xf0, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1B01 rax=0x1 => #UD
.byte 0x66, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1B01 rax=0x1 => #UD
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1B01 rax=0x1 cpl=3 => #GP
# --- RDMSRLIST (F2 0F 01 C6) / WRMSRLIST (F3 0F 01 C6), U802: RSI = MSR-address table, RDI =
# data table, RCX = entry mask (bit n cleared when entry n is done); IA32_BARRIER (2FH) reads 0
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xb9, 0x0b, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x48, 0x8d, 0xbf, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0xB m+0x8000=020100C000000000011B00000000000000000000FFFFFFFFE100000000000000 m+0x9000=78563412FF7F00000100000000000000ADDE0000000000000001000000000000 => rcx=0x0 rdi=0x30029100 m+0x9100=78563412FF7F m+0x9108=01 m+0x9119=01
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1 m+0x8000=2F00000000000000 m+0x9000=1111111111111111 => rcx=0x0 m+0x9000=0000000000000000
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0x48, 0x8d, 0xbf, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00, 0x00, 0xb9, 0x20, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x8000000000000020 m+0x8028=E100000000000000 m+0x81F8=011B000000000000 m+0x9028=FC0F000000000000 m+0x91F8=0100000000000000 => rcx=0x0 rdi=0x30029200 m+0x9228=FC0F
.byte 0x66, 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6, 0xf3, 0x48, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x0 rsi=0x30028040 rdi=0x30029040 =>
.byte 0x66, 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x2 m+0x8008=011B000000000000 m+0x9008=0100000000000000 => rcx=0x0
# an entry with bits 63:32 set / a value WRMSR refuses / IA32_BARRIER written: #GP(0) at that
# entry, the entries before it completed (RCX bits cleared), RAX/RDX unchanged
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x3 rax=0xAAAA rdx=0xDDDD m+0x8000=011B000000000000E100000001000000 m+0x9000=01000000000000000000000000000000 => rcx=0x2 #GP
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x3 m+0x8000=011B0000000000002F00000000000000 m+0x9000=01000000000000000000000000000000 => rcx=0x2 #GP
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x5 m+0x8000=E1000000000000000000000000000000930D000000000000 m+0x9000=000100000000000000000000000000000000100000000000 => rcx=0x4 #GP
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1 m+0x8000=011B000000000000 m+0x9000=0200000000000000 => #GP
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x3 m+0x8000=2F000000000000002F00000010000000 m+0x9000=05000000000000000500000000000000 => rcx=0x2 m+0x9000=00 #GP
# RSI / RDI not 8-byte aligned: #GP(0) before any entry (also with RCX = 0); RCX = 0: nothing
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1 rsi=0x30028004 m+0x8004=2F00000000000000 => #GP
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1 rdi=0x30029001 m+0x8000=011B000000000000 => #GP
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x0 rsi=0x30028002 => #GP
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x0 rsi=0x30040000 rdi=0x30050000 =>
# #PF on a table access (MEM + 10000h is unmapped): partial completion
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x3 rsi=0x3002FFF8 m+0xFFF8=2F00000000000000 m+0x9000=0700000000000000 => rcx=0x2 m+0x9000=00 #PF
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x3 rdi=0x3002FFF8 m+0x8000=2F000000000000002F00000000000000 m+0xFFF8=0700000000000000 => rcx=0x2 m+0xFFF8=00 #PF
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x2 rdi=0x3002FFF8 m+0x8008=011B000000000000 => #PF
# LOCK -> #UD; CPL3 -> #GP(0)
.byte 0xf0, 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1 m+0x8000=2F00000000000000 => #UD
.byte 0xf0, 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1 m+0x8000=011B000000000000 => #UD
